correctness.rationale: Exact last-reset representation combines two independent Gaussian variances to a thermal-width Gaussian independent of age, leaving a signed Beta(a,1) shift. For a<=1 strict unimodality follows via a positive mixture of uniform kernels; for a>1 an exact distributional derivative and strict monotonicity of sinh(uw)/sinh(w) yield at most one positive critical point. H_a(t) is continuous, increases strictly from below 1 to infinity, giving one and only one critical separation. Uniform small-w expansion proves the quartically flat threshold and m²=3(s_c−s)+o(s_c−s); endpoint limits and the a=2 root are derived, not numerically presumed. Standalone standard-library checker reproduced 59 numerical consistency assertions, which are corroborative only.

value.rationale: A physically motivated idealization prepares two thermalized, broadened packets in the same bath as the harmonic evolution. The exact finite-width modal transition and all-global-mode classification answer whether separated preparations remain distinguishable at steady state. They reveal a nontrivial separation-dependent boundary missed by the point-reset rate-only threshold and a quantitatively sharp mode-opening law. The claim is a complete natural structural classification, not a bare kernel substitution or arbitrary numerical slice.
